constructor_season.name: constructor_season
constructor_season.title: Constructor seasons
constructor_season.description: One row per team lineage and season. Points and positions are from the official final constructor standings.

constructor_id.description: Constructor ID as used by Jolpica-F1 that season

points.description: Final championship points (includes sprint points and penalties)

races_entered.description: Grands Prix with at least one car classified or retired

classified_finishes.description: Car entries recorded as finished or lapped

mechanical_dnfs.transformation: Count of race statuses classified as mechanical (src/f1moneyball/standardization/teams.py)
mechanical_dnfs.description: Retirements with a mechanical cause recorded. Under-counted from 2024 where status is often just "Retired"

mean_grid_to_finish.transformation: Mean of grid minus finishing position, classified cars only; pit-lane start counted as last on grid
mean_grid_to_finish.missing_treatment: Blank if the team had no classified finish that season
mean_grid_to_finish.description: Mean of (grid - finish) for classified cars. Positive = gained places

median_quali_gap_pct.transformation: Per session: (team's best time / fastest time - 1) x 100; then median over the season
median_quali_gap_pct.missing_treatment: Blank if no valid qualifying time was recorded
median_quali_gap_pct.description: Median across the season of the team's best car gap to pole

poles.description: Sessions where the team's best car set the fastest qualifying time

points_share.transformation: points / sum of all teams' points in the season
points_share.description: Team points / all teams' points that season

median_pit_gap_s.transformation: Per race: team median service stop - fastest team median (same race, same pit lane); then median over races. Stops over 60 s excluded
median_pit_gap_s.missing_treatment: Blank before 2011 or if the team had no comparable race
median_pit_gap_s.description: Median over the season's races of the team's pit stop gap to the fastest team in that race

pit_races.description: Races in which the team's pit stop gap could be computed

service_pit_stops.description: Pit stops of 60 seconds or less in the season

limitations: Points systems changed (fastest-lap point 2019 to 2024, sprint races from 2021). Compare points_share or position across eras, not raw points.
Mechanical retirements are under-counted from 2024, when many retirements are recorded only as 'Retired'.
Team lineages are a modelling choice: a rebrand is treated as the same team if the factory stays the same.
Until the automated pull runs, rows come from a checked standings snapshot: points, position and wins only.

race_result.name: race_result
race_result.title: Race results
race_result.description: One row per car per Grand Prix from the Jolpica-F1 race results endpoint, with retirement causes classified.

position.description: Finishing order position as published (also given for non-classified cars)

position_text.description: Position as text; R = retired, D = disqualified, etc.

status_class.description: finished | mechanical | incident | disqualified | not_started | unspecified | other

is_mechanical_dnf.description: True if retirement cause is mechanical

grid_to_finish.description: Grid minus finishing position for classified cars

limitations: Sprint race results are not included.
Retirement causes are often unspecified from 2024.

pit_stop.name: pit_stop
pit_stop.title: Pit stops
pit_stop.description: One row per pit stop from the Jolpica-F1 pit stop endpoint (2011 onwards), with the team and each team's gap to the fastest team in the same race.

constructor_id.description: Constructor ID, from the race results

team_id.transformation: Joined from race results on season, round and driver

stop.description: Stop number for the driver in that race

is_long_stop.description: True if over 60 seconds or missing (red-flag wait, repair); excluded from team comparisons

team_median_s.missing_treatment: Blank for long stops or if fewer than 3 teams had service stops in the race
team_median_s.description: Team's median service stop in this race

gap_to_best_team_s.description: team_median_s minus the fastest team's median in the same race

limitations: Duration is total pit-lane time (entry to exit), not the stationary tyre change. It depends on the length of each pit lane, so seconds are compared only within a race.
Stops over 60 seconds (red-flag waits, repairs) are kept but flagged and left out of team comparisons.
The source does not label penalty or repair stops. Only the 60-second rule separates them, so short penalty stops stay in.

competitive_balance.name: competitive_balance
competitive_balance.title: Competitive balance by season
competitive_balance.description: Concentration and mobility indicators computed from final constructor points.

hhi_normalized.description: HHI adjusted for number of teams. 0 = equal shares

cv.description: Coefficient of variation of constructor points

top3_share.description: Points share of the top three teams

winner_share_of_wins.description: Share of race wins taken by the team with most wins

leader_points_share.description: Points share of the champion constructor

rank_persistence.missing_treatment: Blank for the first season in the window (no previous season)
rank_persistence.description: Spearman correlation of team rank with previous season rank

mean_abs_rank_change.missing_treatment: Blank for the first season in the window
mean_abs_rank_change.description: Mean absolute change in team rank from previous season

limitations: Computed from final constructor points only. Says nothing about race-by-race uncertainty.
HHI and Gini depend on the number of teams; use hhi_normalized when the grid size changes.
Descriptive indicators. A change after 2021 is not evidence that the cost cap caused it.

regulation_event.name: regulation_event
regulation_event.title: Regulation events
regulation_event.description: Financial, technical, sporting and power-unit rule changes with effective dates and sources.

value.description: Numeric value where relevant (e.g. cap level)

verified_against_primary.description: True once checked against the FIA document

limitations: Cost-cap values are sourced to secondary reporting until checked against the FIA regulations (see verified_against_primary).
Base cap levels only. Adjustments for extra races and inflation are not included.

financial_observation.name: financial_observation
financial_observation.title: Financial observations
financial_observation.description: One row per reported or estimated financial figure, with full provenance. Entered manually and validated.

season_mapped.description: Season this financial year is mapped to (documented rule)

entity_name.description: Legal entity that reported the figure

value.missing_treatment: Blank only when source_class = missing. Never estimated to fill a gap.
value.description: Original figure as reported, in full units of the original currency

document_title.description: Title of the source document (e.g. 'Annual report and financial statements, year ended 31 December 2022')

publication_date.description: Date the source was published or filed

retrieval_date.description: Date the figure was extracted from the document

transformation.description: Any change made to the reported figure (e.g. 'sign flipped: loss reported in brackets'). 'none' if copied as reported.

comparability_warning.description: Why this figure may not be comparable with other teams or years. Required for estimates.

limitations: Figures belong to legal entities, not to 'teams'. An entity may include engine work or other business, or miss costs held in another company.
Accounting periods and currencies differ. Values are never converted or combined in this table.
Coverage is limited to entities that file comparable accounts, mainly in the UK.

efficiency.name: efficiency
efficiency.title: Financial efficiency indicators
efficiency.description: Descriptive comparison of each team's share of points with its share of resources, within groups of teams reporting the same measure, in the same currency, for the same season.

season.description: Season the financial year is mapped to

metric.description: Financial measure used (one per row; measures are never combined)

value.description: Reported figure in original currency units

entity_name.description: Legal entity that reported the figure

exclusion_reason.description: Why the row is not in a comparison group. Blank if included.

points_share.description: Share of all teams' points (whole grid)

is_reported.description: True for audited or officially disclosed figures; false for estimates

group_n_teams.description: Teams in the comparison group (season, metric, currency)

resource_share.missing_treatment: Blank when the row is excluded
resource_share.description: Team value / sum of values in the group

points_share_in_group.missing_treatment: Blank when the row is excluded
points_share_in_group.description: Team points / points of teams in the group

efficiency_ratio.missing_treatment: Blank when the row is excluded
efficiency_ratio.description: points_share_in_group / resource_share. Above 1: more points share than resource share

points_per_million.missing_treatment: Blank when the row is excluded

resource_rank.description: Rank by value within the group (1 = largest)

points_rank.description: Rank by points within the group (1 = most)

rank_gap.description: resource_rank minus points_rank. Positive: finished higher than resources rank

included.description: True if the row is in a comparison group

limitations: Descriptive ratio, not a measure of technical or production efficiency, and not causal.
Shares cover only the teams in the comparison group, not the whole grid.
No currency conversion: teams reporting in different currencies are never in the same group.
Legal-entity accounts may not capture the full cost of running a team.

model_results.name: model_results
model_results.title: Resources and performance models
model_results.description: Regression estimates of points share on the previous season's log resources, by financial measure.

specification.description: Pooled OLS | Team fixed effects | Team and season fixed effects

estimated.description: False when the sample is too small to estimate

effect_10pct_pp.description: Change in points share associated with 10% more resources last season

limitations: Associations, not causal effects. Lagging resources reduces but does not remove reverse causality.
With few teams, clustered standard errors are unreliable.
Fixed-effects estimates rely on small within-team changes and are imprecise.

cost_cap_models.name: cost_cap_models
cost_cap_models.title: Cost cap models
cost_cap_models.description: Interrupted time series, placebo break years and dose-response estimates for the 2021 cost cap.

indicator.description: Outcome (balance indicator, or points_share for dose_response)

break_year.description: Season of the (real or placebo) break

specification.description: A: level and slope change; B: adds a 2022 technical-reset dummy; or the dose-response specification

estimated.description: False when the sample is too small

level_change.description: Estimated level change at the break (ITS), or exposure x post coefficient (dose-response)

slope_change.description: Change in trend after the break (ITS)

placebo_share_as_large.description: Share of placebo breaks with a level change at least as large in absolute value

exposure_measure.description: Financial measure and years used for exposure (dose-response)

limitations: No untreated control group: every team was capped in 2021.
The 2022 technical reset follows one season later; spec B separates them using 2021 alone.
Only five capped seasons with comparable rules (2021-2025).
Dose-response results are suggestive: big spenders may also have adapted differently to the 2022 rules.

cost_cap_event_study.name: cost_cap_event_study
cost_cap_event_study.title: Cost cap event study
cost_cap_event_study.description: Season-by-season coefficient on exposure (standardised log pre-cap resources) in a points-share regression with team and season effects, relative to 2020.

is_reference.description: True for the reference season (fixed at 0)

limitations: Reference season 2020 is a COVID-19 season.
Few teams: clustered standard errors are unreliable.
Pre-cap coefficients near zero support, but do not prove, parallel trends.
